qualitative.gate_2_reason: Discretionary travel-retail and airport luxury concessions easily forgone by travelers; captive airport landlords extract economic rents through concession fees.
qualitative.note: Fails Gate 2 (Discretionary Travel Retail, REJECT). Airport duty-free shopping and concessions represent discretionary, non-essential impulse purchases that travelers readily forgo during economic slumps. Airport authorities act as monopoly landlords capturing surplus via concession tenders.
qualitative.evidence: Avolta (Dufry + Autogrill) relies on international airline passenger footfall. Concession agreements feature high minimum guaranteed fees (MAGs) paid to airport operators, while sales mix is heavily tilted toward deferrable duty-free luxury, cosmetics, alcohol, and tobacco.
